content: Firebase Auth has no native 'deny signup, allow signin' switch — any Google account can complete sign-in via FirebaseUI/SDK by default. For single-admin apps, must add explicit post-auth authorization check (compare signed-in UID or email against a hardcoded allowlist) client-side (redirect/sign-out unauthorized users) AND enforce via Firestore/Storage security rules (UID check), since client-side gating alone is bypassable.
